map.有两种常见形式：::ffff:192.0.2.1（IPv4 映射的 IPv6 地: There are two common forms: ::ffff:192.0.2.1 (an IPv4-mapped IPv6 address, used by dual-stack sockets) and 64:ff9b::192.0.2.1 (the well-known NAT64 prefix). In compressed notation the last 32 bits are often written in dotted decimal, and they are easy to overlook once expanded to pure hexadecimal, so take extra care when checking rules.
map.前缀长度必须是 0–128 的整数。: Prefix length must be an integer from 0 to 128.
map.地址转小写并去空白后，若末段含点分十进制 IPv4（如 ::ffff:192.0: Lowercase and trim the address; if the last segment contains dotted-decimal IPv4 (e.g. ::ffff:192.0.2.1), convert the low 32 bits into two hexadecimal groups first (192.0.2.1 → c000:0201). When double colons are present, split at :: into left and right parts; the number of groups to fill = 8 − left groups − right groups; fewer than 1 group or a second :: makes it invalid. Fill with the required all-zero groups to form 8 groups. If the group count is not 8, or any group is not 1–4 hexadecimal digits, the address is invalid. Pad each group to 4 digits. Output the full form (8 groups joined by colons), the canonical compressed form using the longest all-zero run per RFC 5952, and each group with its index.
